games.name: Apex Legends Mobile
games.gameplay: A lightning-fast battle royale built around iconic Legends, tactical abilities, wall-sliding movement, and intense squad-based combat. Stylish gunfights, clutch revives, and insane mobility made it a fan favorite 💨🔥 Sadly, it burned bright and disappeared too soon.

games.name: Call of Duty: Mobile
games.gameplay: A complete Call of Duty experience on mobile featuring classic multiplayer modes, ranked matches, zombies, and a massive battle royale. Fast gunplay, responsive controls, and constant updates keep the action fresh 🎮⚡.

faqs.question: Is Apex Legends Mobile playable today?
faqs.answer: No ❌ EA officially shut down Apex Legends Mobile in 2023.

faqs.question: Which game should you play right now?
faqs.answer: Call of Duty: Mobile 🏆 is the clear choice with active servers and regular updates.

faqs.question: Which game had the best movement?
faqs.answer: Apex Legends Mobile 💨 had unmatched mobility and fluid combat.

faqs.question: Which game is better for long-term players?
faqs.answer: Call of Duty: Mobile offers steady progression, ranked play, and long-term support 🔥
